private_selection.scope: Private tuning data, separate from held-out public evaluation. Original spilled geometry never selected publicly.

sass_phase_analysis.scope: Exact graph-bound SASS, one backward edge identified as steady key-block loop by unchanged source first-block/remaining-key-block structure. Counts are static sites, not runtime percentages; normalize warp count and key/output work before comparison. No separately assigned drain phase for this one-stage source.

limitations: Complete attention-call comparison only; FA2 and SDPA retain their own arithmetic policies.

First public timing harness failed before its first window because CPU FP64 metrics received a CUDA output; output copied to CPU outside timing in a new immutable continuation, with all GPU/runtime sources unchanged and prior passed gates verified.
Original broad racecheck timeout124 has no successful final tool summary; a collective retry was intentionally stopped before timing, and scoped largest-case tool processes completed successfully.
GPU ownership passes preserved only through exact actual loaded-cubin SHA equality; host/public API correctness and complete-call costs measured anew.
Hardware performance counters were unavailable in the earlier retained GB10 attempt; no stall/utilization/bandwidth ceiling inferred.
